summary.intent: Run the full autonomous post-execute-phase ship pipeline (verify → secure → validate → simplify → SDK E2E gate → CodeRabbit → ship → resolve PR reviews) for GSD Phase 68 in the cipher-box repo, without stopping for user input except on real gate failures or the final merge decision.
summary.outcome: Verify step accepted the existing PASS verdict; Validate was completed retroactively (0 gaps, SDK/API unit suites re-confirmed green) and committed; commit-reword step was a no-op since all 86 branch commits were already conventional; security audit, simplify review, and the SDK E2E gate were dispatched as parallel background jobs, with the SDK E2E suite finishing green (exit 0) and the 68-SECURITY.md doc subsequently committed. The transcript ends before reaching the CodeRabbit CLI review, ship, and PR-review-resolution steps.

repo: Conventional-commit check on this branch: scope-in-parens (e.g. `feat(scope):`) is valid; the 'no parentheses' commitlint rule only applies to the description part, not the scope — don't assume parens always need stripping before checking conventionality.

68-VALIDATION.md pre-existed but only contained the planning-time strategy, not an actual post-hoc audit — required a retroactive Nyquist pass (per-task map + audit trail) before it could be marked compliant/0-gaps.

SDK E2E gate prerequisites: postgres on 5432, kubo on 5001, redis on 6380, mock-ipns-routing on 3001 must already be up; client chain must be rebuilt in order (crypto → core → api-client → sdk-core → sdk → api) so dist matches CI before running @cipherbox/sdk-e2e.
workflow: gsd-secure-phase and gsd-validate-phase both have a 3-state input detector (SECURITY/VALIDATION file exists → audit; only PLAN/SUMMARY exist → reconstruct; no SUMMARY → phase not executed, exit) and a short-circuit rule: if threats_open is 0 AND the register was authored at plan time AND ASVS level is 1, skip the auditor agent entirely — but must NOT skip if ASVS >= 2 or if the register wasn't plan-time-authored (retroactive-STRIDE mode required instead).

Independent long-running steps (security auditor agent, simplify-review agent, SDK client-chain build/E2E run) were kicked off as concurrent background jobs while the orchestrator kept checking PR/gh state and validation work in the foreground — matches the phase's instruction to parallelize independent checks.

Task-notification for a background bash job reports exit code, but the actual pass/fail semantics still need to be verified by reading the real output file (e.g. checking for skip conditions in the SDK E2E log) rather than trusting 'exit code 0' alone.

open_items: CodeRabbit CLI review, conventional PR title/body creation via gh api PATCH, force-push after commit-reword (though reword ended up being a no-op), and PR-review thread resolution steps had not been reached yet in this transcript.
